course.title: Microprocessors and Microcontrollers
course.department: Department of Computer Science and Engineering

content.value: Is it possible to achieve 1 Gbyte of logical or virtual address space using Memory Management Units (MMUs) in 80286, 80386 and 80486 microprocessors? If it is possible, then explain how this 1Gbyte can be achieved using proper diagram(s). Otherwise, give proper logic why it is not possible to achieve 1Gbyte of logical or virtual address space in 80286, 80386 and 80486.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 2nd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2020
